bib.title: ViLBERT: Pretraining Task-Agnostic Visiolinguistic Representations for Vision-and-Language Tasks

question: Can visual grounding be pretrained as a task-agnostic capability on paired image-text data and transferred to several vision-and-language tasks with only minor architecture additions?
hypothesis: A two-stream BERT with co-attentional layers, pretrained with masked multi-modal modelling and alignment prediction on Conceptual Captions, beats single-stream models and task-specific SOTA.
contributions: ViLBERT: two-stream BERT-style model over image regions and text with co-attentional transformer layers
Two proxy pretraining tasks (masked multi-modal modelling, multi-modal alignment prediction) on Conceptual Captions
Transfer to VQA, VCR, RefCOCO+ and caption-based image retrieval (plus zero-shot retrieval) with only a classifier added, SOTA on all four

method.summary: Two parallel BERT-style streams (text initialised from BERT-BASE, vision over Faster R-CNN region features) interact via co-attention layers where keys/values are swapped across streams. Pretrained on ~3.1M Conceptual Captions pairs with masked multi-modal modelling (KL to detector class distribution for regions) and alignment prediction, then fine-tuned end-to-end per task.
method.task: vision-and-language pretraining and transfer (VQA, VCR, referring expressions, caption-based image retrieval)

datasets.name: Conceptual Captions
datasets.size: ~3.1 million image-caption pairs (3.3M released; some links broken)
datasets.split: random 25% and 50% subsets used for data-size ablation
datasets.source: Sharma et al. 2018, alt-text web images
datasets.preprocessing: Alignment negatives: randomly replace image or caption with another

datasets.name: VQA 2.0
datasets.size: 1.1 million questions about COCO images, 10 answers each; 3,129 answer classes

datasets.name: VCR
datasets.size: 290k multiple-choice QA problems from 110k movie scenes
datasets.split: private test set; test numbers only for full model

datasets.name: RefCOCO+
datasets.source: Kazemzadeh et al. 2014; proposals from MAttNet (Mask R-CNN pretrained on COCO)

datasets.name: Flickr30k
datasets.split: 1,000 images validation, 1,000 test, rest train (splits of Lee et al. 2018)

models.name: ViLBERT
models.init_from: linguistic stream from BERT-BASE (BookCorpus + English Wikipedia); visual stream not stated
models.layers: linguistic stream 12 transformer layers base; ablated 2/4/6/8 CO-TRM->TRM blocks (6 for main model, inferred from Table 1 = 6-layer row)
models.hidden: 1024 visual stream; 762 linguistic (as printed; likely a typo)

other.regions: 10 to 36 boxes per image above a confidence threshold (threshold value not stated)
other.region_feature: mean-pooled conv feature, Faster R-CNN ResNet-101 pretrained on Visual Genome
other.spatial: 5-d vector (normalised top-left, bottom-right, area fraction) projected and summed

models.name: ViLBERT-dagger / Single-Stream-dagger
models.architecture: no Conceptual Captions pretraining; BERT init for text stream

training.objective: Pretraining: masked multi-modal modelling (~15% words and regions masked; words as BERT; regions zeroed 90%/unaltered 10%; KL divergence to detector class distribution) + alignment prediction (binary, linear layer on elementwise product of h_IMG and h_CLS); two losses weighted equally
training.warmup: warm up used, length not stated

other.finetune VQA: two-layer MLP on elementwise product, BCE on soft targets, batch 256, max 20 epochs, Adam lr 4e-5
other.finetune VCR: linear layer, four question+answer inputs, softmax, CE, 20 epochs, batch 64, lr 2e-5
other.finetune RefCOCO+: linear layer per region, BCE, IoU threshold 0.5, max 20 epochs, batch 256, lr 4e-5
other.finetune retrieval: 4-way multiple choice (random caption, random image, hard negative from 100 nearest neighbours), CE, 20 epochs, batch 64, lr 2e-5; linguistic stream cached before first Co-TRM

inference.decoding: VQA softmax; RefCOCO+ highest scoring region; retrieval: score all pairs and sort; text sampling (Fig 5) by MCMC resampling from all-MASK per Wang and Cho 2019

metrics.name: VCR Q->A, QA->R, Q->AR
metrics.definition: multiple-choice accuracy; Q->AR requires both correct

metrics.name: Image retrieval R1/R5/R10
metrics.definition: recall at k on Flickr30k 1,000-image test pool

eval.protocol: Single runs per cell; no seeds, error bars or significance tests reported.

evidence.quote: hidden state size of 762 and 12 attention heads

limits: No seeds, variance or significance tests reported.
Text generation unsolved: authors say it is unclear how to decode from the bidirectional model; captioning, dialog, embodied tasks and long sequences not addressed.
Single-Stream not evaluated on retrieval or zero-shot retrieval because it cannot cache representations (high cost).
Authors use BERT-BASE for training-time concerns; BERT-LARGE might help.
Fixed external detector features; detector cost not reported; confidence threshold, warmup length and VCR/RefCOCO+ details unspecified.
Pretrained-model captions are editorialised due to alt-text data.

terms.definition: co-attentional transformer layer: keys and values from each modality are passed to the other modality's multi-headed attention block

figures.caption: Our ViLBERT model consists of two parallel streams for visual and linguistic processing that interact through novel co-attentional transformer layers.
figures.why: shows the two-stream layout and repeated Co-TRM blocks
